note: B2B revenue platform. BCV's own listing gives 2015 (Ajay Agarwal) and 'Early', an anchor that names no round; no source ties BCV to a named 2015 round, so the stage is undetermined. Mark: the $200M Series E of Jan 2022 at $5.2B (PR Newswire), fresher than the prefilled $2.1B Series D (2021); no later priced round, stale beyond 24 months.

Healthcare IT network (Minneapolis). Acquired by Inovalon in 2018 (the firm's listing: 'ABILITY Network (Inovalon)', Acquired). BCV's 2011 entry (Jeff Crisan on the Form D) is prefilled from the filings.

Virtual behavioral-health provider. Acquired by UnitedHealth's Optum in 2020 for about $470M (CNBC, https://www.cnbc.com/2020/04/27/unitedhealth-near-buying-telehealth-provider-ableto-for-470-million.html). BCV entered in 2018 (Yumin Choi's Form D, 2018-06-06); the firm's listing tags the entry Growth; AbleTo had raised since 2008, so the 2018 round was a later-stage one.
Wound-care centre operator (Bellevue, WA per the firm's 2010 listing; the 2013 Form D gives Denver). Acquired by Healogics (the firm's archived listing: 'Acquired by Healogics').

Micro-investing app (Irvine). BCV's listing gives 2017 and 'Early' (an anchor); no source names the round BCV entered. Mark: the $300M private round of March 2022 at $1.9B after the scrapped SPAC (CNBC), replacing the prefilled $2.2B SPAC valuation that never closed; stale beyond 24 months.

Wholesale used-car auction marketplace (Buffalo), IPO March 2021 (NASDAQ: ACVA). BCV's funds are Bain Capital Venture Fund 2019 and BCV 2019-MD Primary (ACV's investors' rights agreement, S-1 exhibit 10.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1637873/000119312521060598/d34258dex101.htm), so BCV entered after the February 2018 $31M Series C, which Bessemer, Tribeca, SoftBank NY and Armory Square led without BCV (https://www.autoremarketing.com/ar/technology/acv-auctions-lands-31-million-series-c-funding/): a Growth entry. Market cap to be pinned in the A/B pass.

Display-ad platform (Seattle), later part of CPXi / Digital Remedy (the firm's listing: Acquired). BCV's 2007 listing year predates the first Form D the filings tie to Ajay Agarwal (2010-04, $5.3M), so the band is withheld and no source names BCV's 2007 round.

Spend-management platform (San Francisco), acquired by Paylocity in 2024. BCV's listing: 2017, Seed; the firm then led the 2020 Series A ('Bain Capital Ventures led the Series A funding round in Airbase', its own post), which graduates the seed.

Digital identity app (Herndon, VA). 'We had recently invested at the seed stage in a company called Airside' and BCV then led the $13M Series B (the firm's post, 2020-11-11). Acquired by Onfido in 2023 (https://www.bizjournals.com/washington/news/2023/05/22/airside-mobile-onfido-digital-id-acquisition.html); the prefilled status stands.

AI-native FP&A software (New York). BCV entered with the round Christina Melas-Kyriazi's Form D records (2023-09-21), part of the $16.7M seed-and-Series-A Aleph announced on leaving stealth (businesswire 2023-10-24); a $29M Series B followed in 2025 (GlobeNewswire). The filing band reads Series A; the company was incorporated in 2020, so the band was withheld and is taken here with the announcement's Series A.

Alloy Automation, e-commerce integration and automation (San Francisco), not the Alloy of the identity-fraud sibling rows. 'Bain Capital Ventures led a $5 million seed financing for Alloy' (the firm's post, 2021-02-02); the $20M Series A followed in February 2022 (TechCrunch). Wikidata's AU belongs to another Alloy.

European wholesale marketplace (Paris). 'BCV first invested in Ankorstore in May 2021, co-leading the company's $102M Series B' (the firm's post). The prefilled mark is the January 2022 Series C at about $2B (https://techcrunch.com/2022/01/09/ankorstore-reaches-2-billion-valuation-two-years-after-launching-its-wholesale-marketplace/).

Healthcare AI analytics (San Mateo). Centene closed its purchase in December 2020 (https://www.healthcaredive.com/news/centene-closes-buy-of-analytics-firm-apixio/591900/). BCV entered with the 2013-11 round Jared Kesselheim's Form D records ($2.5M), in a company incorporated in 2009 that had raised before, so the band is withheld and the round is not named in any source read.

Backup and recovery software (Reston, VA). 'In 2008, AppAssure Software received a Series A investment by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia). Acquired by Dell in February 2012 (the firm's archived page).
Network performance monitoring (Boston; formerly Apparent Networks, Vancouver). Acquired by Broadcom (the firm's listing). BCV invested in 2007; no source names the round.

Data and analytics for government and retail (Louisville). The firm's 2010 archive files it under 'Expansion/Growth Buyout' and 'Acquired by Insight Venture Partners'; Clearlake and Insight later backed it. No source says whether BCV's 2007 position was a minority or a control stake, so it is kept as a member and the round is undetermined; raised for review.

Branded resale platform (San Francisco). 'BCV first invested in Archive in their pre-seed round' and co-led the seed (the firm's post, 2022-01-26), so the entry is Pre-Seed, not the listing's Seed (decisions.md R2 names this case). Series A $15M (2022) and $30M (2025) followed; the company operates. Wikidata's 'acquired' and ZA belong to another 'Archive'.

Payroll-connectivity API (New York). BCV joined the 2019 seed ('our prior participation in Argyle's seed round last year') and led the $20M Series A in 2020 (the firm's post); a $30M Series C followed in 2024. The Form D band (Growth, 2022) reads a later filing; Wikidata's 'defunct' belongs to another Argyle.

IoT and asset security (founded in Israel; San Francisco HQ). BCV's listing gives 2018 (Enrique Salem): the $30M Series B of April 2018 (Calcalist) or the $65M Series C of 2019, both Growth. Insight bought control at $1.1B in 2020; ServiceNow closed its $7.75B purchase in April 2026 (https://www.ynetnews.com/business/article/r1z11dpnpwx).

Mobile messaging for commerce (New York). BCV led the Series A (its own post, 2018-03-14), which the filings also give. Mark: the $230M Series D (September 2020, Coatue) at $2.2B, the last priced round read here; later rounds reported at $5B+ are to be pinned in the A/B pass (siblings: Atomico $5B 2021, Sequoia $2.7B 2025).

Identity and deception security (Fremont). SentinelOne agreed to buy it in March 2022 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220315005546/en/SentinelOne-to-Acquire-Attivo-Networks-Bringing-Identity-to-XDR). BCV's listing gives 2014 (Enrique Salem); no source names the round.

Network AIOps (Palo Alto). Nvidia acquired it in 2025 (https://www.sdxcentral.com/news/nvidia-quietly-acquires-aiops-firm-augtera-networks/). BCV's listing: 2016, Seed. Graduation left for the graduation pass.
Auto-repair shop software (Toronto). 'Bain Capital Ventures is proud to have led AutoLeap's Series A' ($18M, 2021); a $30M Series B followed in 2023 (TechCrunch).
Accounts-payable automation (Charlotte). IPO October 2021; taken private by TPG in 2025, so acquired stands. BCV entered at the 2015 round the filings give (Matt Harris).

Network detection and response (Santa Clara). Acquired by Arista Networks in 2020 after a $36M Series C that April (FinTech Global). BCV's listing gives 2016 (Enrique Salem); no source names its entry round.

SaaS operations management (New York). 'In April 2018, BetterCloud raised $60 million in a Series E funding led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia). Vista Equity Partners bought a majority stake in June 2022 (https://siliconangle.com/2022/06/09/vista-equity-partners-buys-majority-stake-cloud-service-management-startup-bettercloud/).
Inventory software for food and beverage (Boston); raised a $5.25M round in 2015 (Boston Globe). Operating; entry round from the filings.

B2B invoicing and payments (Lawrenceville, NJ). BCV wrote 'the first outside check into Billtrust in 2012' (the firm's post): a growth-equity investment in a profitable company founded in 2001 (Matt Harris on the board since November 2012, per Justworks' S-1). Public via SPAC (BTRS) in 2021; taken private by EQT for $1.7B in 2022.

Web video network (New York). 'Financed by Bain Capital Ventures, Canaan Partners, and Ambient Sound Investments' (Wikipedia); BCV entered in 2010 with the $10M round the NYT reported (2010-05). Maker Studios acquired Blip in 2013 and closed the site in 2015: a sale of the company, so acquired (COLLECTION.md s6).

Commerce personalisation (Mountain View). BCV invested in 2009 (Ajay Agarwal), the company's founding year; no source read names the round. Mark: the $175M Series F at $2.2B (February 2022); stale beyond 24 months.

basis: Blue Coat was bought from Thoma Bravo in Bain Capital's 2016 buyout, with BCIP Venture Associates among the buyout investors (Blue Coat's registration-rights agreement, DRS 2016-01-29): a control acquisition, not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3; decisions.md D4).

note: Online retailer (Eden Prairie; formerly Fingerhut Direct Marketing). 'Bain Capital' in its 2011 S-1 means Bain Capital Venture Fund, L.P. and affiliates; the company was sold to Capmark Financial in 2014 and later to Chinese investors. Entry from the filings.

basis: BMC Software, a listed company, was taken private in 2013 by Bain Capital, Golden Gate, GIC and Insight: a control acquisition of a public company, not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3; decisions.md D4; config verify.not_members).

note: Salon and spa scheduling software (New York). 'On April 16, 2013, Booker secured $27.5 million in Series B financing led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia). Acquired by Mindbody in 2018.

Cardiovascular diagnostics lab (Framingham). Acquired by Eurofins Scientific (the firm's listing). BCV's listing gives 2010 and the first partner-anchored Form D is 2011 ($6.5M) in a company incorporated in 2007, so the band is withheld; the round is not named.
Packet-optical networking (Ottawa). Acquired by Juniper Networks in 2016.

Group-buying site (Boston). 'In 2010, BuyWithMe was funded with $36.5M by Matrix Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, and Pinnacle Ventures' (Wikipedia); acquired by Gilt City in November 2011 (the firm's archived page). The round names are not given.

Early-stage clinical research (Lincoln, NE), formed in 2010 from MDS Pharma Services' early clinical business. The firm's archive files it under 'Expansion/Growth Buyout' and 'Acquired by MTS Health Investors'; whether BCV's 2010 position was control is not established, raised for review.

Employer health plans (the 2018 release is datelined New York; the firm lists Buffalo). 'Bain Capital Ventures led the financing round' of the $34M Series A (PR Newswire 2018-07-18); Series B $34M (2020) and $75M (2024) followed.
Expense and invoice automation (Los Angeles). Merged into Emburse in 2019 (the firm's listing). Entry from the filings.

Revenue platform (Sunnyvale). Merged with Vista's Salesloft in late 2025; the combined company operates as 'Clari + Salesloft' (https://www.bizjournals.com/sanjose/news/2026/02/12/clari-salesloft-merger-ai-investments-layoffs.html), so Clari no longer stands alone: acquired, with the successor ambiguity noted (COLLECTION.md s6). Its standalone mark was $2.6B (Series F, January 2022). Sibling Sequoia still reads private $2.6B.

Calendar automation (San Francisco). BCV led the $18M Series B (the firm's post, 2020-06-16). The product shut on 2026-03-27 after Salesforce hired the team without buying the company (the acqui-hire rule: defunct).
Private-cloud infrastructure (Reston, VA; the firm lists Washington, DC). Acquired by Fungible (the firm's listing). BCV's listing gives 2016 (Ben Nye); the round is not named.
Card-linked ad offers (Boston); raised $1.5M in 2010 (Reuters). No trace after the early 2010s; state unknown.

Electronics supply-chain software (New York). BCV's listing: 2021, Seed (and its 2022 post on the investment); the first partner-anchored Form D (2023-09) is a later round, so the band's Series A is overruled. The $17M Series A (December 2024) graduates it.
